cmd.kick.description: Kick a member from the server.
cmd.ban.description: Ban a user from the server.
cmd.timeout.description: Timeout a member for a number of minutes.

cmd.unsubscribe.description: Stop receiving campaign DMs from this server.
cmd.help.description: List NorBot commands available to you.

cmd.status.description: Show bot health for this server.

cmd.lock.description: Lock a text channel (deny @everyone Send Messages).

cmd.level-reset.description: Reset a member's XP (text, voice, or all).
